message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The trajectory repeatedly established the inpatient high-acuity context, enforced NPO/medication boundaries, and produced practical written questions with bedside escalation routes. However, RC2 has a serious omission because immediate escalation teaching never fully covered fever/infection worsening or marked staff-reported blood-pressure/glucose abnormalities, and RC3 has a serious omission because the surfaced atrial-fibrillation/troponin cardiology thread was never tracked for owner, timing, or implications. The known right-neck central line also lacked specific family-facing warning signs, constituting an additional minor RC6 error.
